name: cekdulu
description: cek dulu, baru berangkat. peta kondisi layanan rt sampai kelurahan dari laporan warga.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cekdulu/shared && npm run build -w @cekdulu/db
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @cekdulu/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @cekdulu/api
scripts.db:sql: npm run build -w @cekdulu/shared && npm run schema:sql -w @cekdulu/db
scripts.db:sync: npm run build -w @cekdulu/shared && npm run schema:sync -w @cekdulu/db
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @cekdulu/shared && npm run seed -w @cekdulu/db
